relationship_to_previous: All 12 target+candidate sets new; no reuse of P1.11 or P1.11.1 evaluation tasks.
selection: Fixed corpus and answer indices committed before actual pinned MS MARCO cross-encoder scoring.
proposal_scope: Semantic role disambiguation only; no new executable primitives; not Q3 or Q6 evidence.
gate: PASS only if both correctness thresholds, 12/12 actual one-batch model forwards, no test-reference exposure to model and complete exact-revision provenance.
comparator: Best of TFIDF word unigram/bigram and character 2-5gram cosine. No model training, same text role pairs. Descriptive classical lexical comparator only, not frontier/direct tool baseline.
